_roles: distractor: a competing record, its facts in the answer mean confusion; lure: text on the topic or with the words of the question but without an answer; noise: a striking fact unrelated to the question; value: a part of the right answer, its facts are in answer_key; evidence: a second step the answer needs, it holds the answer

oslov.text: The oldest house in Oslov has a roof of blue slate and a door painted with a white elk.

oslen.text: The oldest house in Oslen has a roof of black slate and a door painted with a white hare.

oslund.text: The oldest house in Oslund has a roof of brown slate and a door painted with a white owl.

oslvik.text: The oldest house in Oslvik has a roof of silver slate and a door painted with a white swan.

oslo_value_2.text: The oldest house in Oslo also has a cellar of rough flint and a chimney shaped like a tall bottle.

oslo_value_3.text: Besides, the oldest house in Oslo has a floor of pine planks and a staircase with nine crooked steps.

bergen.text: The oldest house in Bergen has a roof of grey turf and a door painted with a black raven.
